track_name: Summit Point Raceway - Summit Point Raceway
title: FF1600 Rookie Series Fixed Summit Point Raceway Track Guide 2026 S3

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake just before the free cone, 80% pressure
corners.line: turn-in before free cone, apex at cone, follow lighter gray tarmac
corners.exit: hard on throttle, follow lighter gray tarmac

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: brake in line with access road, 30% pressure
corners.mistakes: easy to overdrive this corner and exit

corners.label: T7
corners.exit: Run the car middle left ready for turn seven

corners.label: T9
corners.line: Bring the car back to the left

corners.braking: Brake as soon as you see the pit road open, 40% pressure
corners.line: Get as close to the inside curve without completely running over it
corners.mistakes: Avoid the gravel at all costs

general_tips: use the dirt on the left of the track as a braking reference
peak at 70-ish percent to get rotation through trail braking
